name: cad-rescue
description: Inspect DXF, SVG and DWG drawings, report layers, units and extents, and create a safe geometry preview. DWG uses a separately installed LibreDWG Web runtime; DXF recovery validates an exported copy while preserving the original. A preview is not a certified CAD repair.

interface.longDescription: Inspect DXF, SVG and DWG drawings, report layers, units and extents, and create a safe geometry preview. DWG uses a separately installed LibreDWG Web runtime; DXF recovery validates an exported copy while preserving the original. A preview is not a certified CAD repair.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this drawing and show its layers, units and bounds.
Create a safe preview of this DXF and explain missing geometry.
Diagnose why this drawing imports at the wrong scale.
